title: Audit: spec fixes since 10-22 incorporated into crates
description: Mark 2026-11-01: make SURE every spec fix landed in the crates. (A) jmap-chat-spec normative commits 2ac2603 (10-22) .. 77c3474 (10-31), plus anything after. (B) upstream IETF draft review findings from jmap-chat-spec epic fph7 (calendars-33, tasks-06, filenode-19, emailpush-04, metadata-05, refplus-02, blobext-02, object-history-02) that imply crate behaviour (e.g. JMAP-j3ic isOrigin). Each check bead: per spec change, verdict incorporated (file:line proof) / missing / not applicable. Every 'missing' gets its own fix bead under this epic.
